# V1.1.1 - Axiom hotfix

Saved sessions larger than 128 MiB can open again. Fate UI reads the selected JSONL session as a stream and keeps a bounded recent preview in memory. A large saved message is shortened in the preview; its full content remains in the session file. Sessions with long histories can still be resumed.

Agent home sessions no longer stop at the former 128 MiB reader limit.

## Installers

The release contains Windows x64 EXE, macOS Apple Silicon and Intel DMG and PKG, Linux x64 AppImage and DEB, and `SHA256SUMS`. The native build, install, and smoke checks must pass on all four runners before the release is published. Installers are unsigned; verify the checksum of your download.
